question: AAKON avocado oil brand company owner manufacturer
markdown:
There is no major consumer brand or manufacturer named **AAKON** that produces avocado oil. You might be thinking of **AAK** (AarhusKarlshamn), a major global Swedish supplier of specialty vegetable oils and fats, or **Aakon Polichimica**, an Italian distributor of cosmetic raw materials and vegetable oils, neither of which sell a direct retail avocado oil brand. [](https://www.facebook.com/100054606512505/mentions/)

If you meant a popular global or locally available avocado oil brand, major producers include:

-   **Chosen Foods:** Owned by Butterfly (a private equity firm) (previously partnered with Sesajal), headquartered in San Diego, California.

-   **Olivado:** Pioneered cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil, with operations in New Zealand, the US, and the UK.

-   **Avomexicano / Avaco:** Popular imported and locally distributed cold-pressed Mexican/New Zealand avocado oil brands available in markets like India. [](https://www.just-food.com/news/avocado-products-maker-chosen-foods-gets-new-majority-ownership/)

If you can check the **exact spelling** or provide **where you saw the name AAKON**, I will gladly research that specific company for you!
